v2_namespaced_limited.note: cgroup namespace: own path is '/', files at the mount root; container id only visible in mountinfo (resolv.conf under containers/<id>, not sandboxes/<id>).

v2_kind_sandbox.note: containerd + cgroup v2 Kubernetes (kind): own path is '/', hostname and resolv.conf come from the pod sandbox (sandboxes/<id> is per pod, never the container id). The only per-container-start source is kubelet's termination-log mount, root /var/lib/kubelet/pods/<uid>/containers/<name>/<suffix> (new suffix on every container start, shared by every process): container_id = k8s:<uid>/<name>/<suffix>.

v2_unlimited.note: 'max' means no limit: limit is null, never a number. memory.swap.current absent -> swap null.

v2_k8s_nested.note: No cgroup namespace: own path is the full kubepods path. The effective limit is the minimum over the leaf and every ancestor up to the mount root (leaf 'max', pod slice 512 MiB / 1 core).

v1_docker.note: v1: the mount root (mountinfo field 4) is the container's own cgroup, so files sit at the mount point. limit_in_bytes 9223372036854771712 is the no-limit sentinel -> null. cpuacct.usage and throttled_time are nanoseconds; report microseconds. anon/file from total_rss/total_cache.

hybrid_v1_controllers.note: Hybrid: a cgroup2 mount exists (/sys/fs/cgroup/unified) but the cpu and memory controllers are v1, so read v1. Decide per controller from mountinfo, not by probing files. cfs_quota_us -1 = no CPU limit.

no_cgroup.note: No cgroup mount in mountinfo: no container numbers at all (null), never zeros.

units: bytes for memory, microseconds for cpu usage and throttling, cores for limit_cores. null = not measurable (absent file, 'max', sentinel).
how: Each case has a fake filesystem under <case>/root. Point the reader's root at it (it reads <root>/proc/self/cgroup, <root>/proc/self/mountinfo and the cgroup files under the mount points named in mountinfo). CPU affinity/cpuset are not in the fixtures: tests inject host cores = 8, so limit_cores is min(quota, 8) or null when there is no quota.
